run_kmeans: run kmeans clustering on a torch tensor with multiple initializations and return the best centroids and cluster assignments
run_kmeans_plusplus: run kmeans++ initialization to select initial cluster centers from a torch tensor of data points
run_assign_clusters: assign data points in a torch tensor to their closest cluster centroids using l2 or cosine distance
run_compute_distance: compute pairwise l2 or cosine distance between rows of two torch tensors using an efficient expanded norm formula
run_sort_cluster_by_distance: sort data points within each cluster by increasing distance to their cluster centroid on GPU
